easy.def: A way to fix a problem.
examples: I found a solution. We can share the toy!
What is the solution to the math problem?
The solution was to ask for help.

more.def: The answer to a problem or the way to fix it.
examples: The solution to the puzzle was hidden in the last clue.
There is no easy solution to the traffic problem.
The class worked together to find a solution.
